notes: TVA standard rate 20% (Code des Impôts, art. 06.01.12). The art. 06.01.06 exemption list contains no general investment-gold exemption; its only gold item exempts gold sold to the Central Bank of Madagascar for the national gold reserve, so retail bullion carries 20%. Import duty HS 7108 null: line rates exist only in the customs eTariff tool.

sources.name: Direction Générale des Impôts - Code des Impôts suivant la Loi de Finances 2025 (portal.impots.mg)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: art. 06.01.12 fixes the normal TVA rate at 20%; art. 06.01.06 item 10 exempts only the sale of gold to the Central Bank for the national gold reserve
